cost.scope: Successful train/forward/score stages run in GPU allocations, plus original TIMEOUT scheduler allocation. Not all startup/export/gates costs are measured; baseline separately reported.

limitations: DEV best-of45 selection; not independent confirmation or TEST.
Matched seed, exported input/roles and schedule, but no recorded initial-tensor or every-minibatch hash. Co-teaching splits intentionally diverge after posterior changes.
All RTX6000PRO; jobs/nodes differ, reused baseline and cudnn.benchmark are not bitwise reproducible.
Reference Q is same-role anchor re-pairing excluding own image, not the exact unconditional full product.
Sparse scalar posterior summaries do not prove clean-pair calibration, hard-positive retention, or gradient causality.
Failed original903 run retained and charged; retry unchanged recipe, no extra retries.

conclusion.task_result: Online VCS posterior gives a modest exploratory DEV best-checkpoint improvement over the original NCR host: +1.65023 rSum, 3/3 seeds positive.
conclusion.vcs_specific_advantage: Not established: VCS minus matched BCE best-checkpoint rSum is +0.71006 on average, with only 1/3 seeds positive.
conclusion.curve_result: VCS minus BCE at the final epoch is +11.72913 (3/3 positive), but last5 mean is +3.60684 (2/3) and last10 +1.13346 (1/3). Terminal advantage is endpoint-sensitive, not evidence of consistent late-stage superiority. Do not replace the registered best-checkpoint comparison with a favorable endpoint.
conclusion.mechanism: No posterior fallback in all 480 model-epoch deployments. Successful deployment does not establish reliability calibration or preservation of hard correct pairs.
conclusion.decision: Do not launch an unselected longer NCR run or hyperparameter grid. Finish existing A3 extensions and dense registration/cost controls. Before any new NCR training, a prospective matched mechanism study must distinguish clean-pair calibration, hard-positive retention and NCR stage-transition sensitivity using FIT/DEV only; current sparse ledger alone does not resolve this.
conclusion.theory: Original theory unchanged. No TEST use or extra parameter selection.
